description: Define sprint goal interactively with the PO
template:
📌 SPRINT_PLANNING.GOAL — Definir goal del sprint

Context layers available:
  • STATE   (layer above) — current project state, previous sprint outcomes
  • CKG     (layer above) — architectural decisions and conventions
    Query: type:decision (decisions that constrain the sprint direction)
  • DELTA   (layer above) — gap between current state and desired goal
    Shows what work remains and what was accomplished in prior sprints
  • PROJECT (layer above) — project conventions and architecture patterns

Instrucción:
  Define el objetivo del sprint, el resultado esperado y los roles.
  Usa las capas STATE, CKG, DELTA y PROJECT para informar la dirección del sprint.

Comando:
  walker <project>/submit '{"goal":"<objetivo>","expected_result":"<resultado>","roles":"<json>"}'

Campos requeridos:
  • goal            : string, mínimo 10 caracteres — objetivo del sprint
  • expected_result : string (opcional) — resultado esperado
  • roles           : objeto (opcional) — roles del equipo
    └─ { dev, qa, po }

Ejemplo:
  walker <project>/submit '{"goal":"Migrar workflow engine a DDD","expected_result":"Capas separadas, tests pasando","roles":{"dev": "agente", "qa": "engine", "po": "usuario"}}'

Output:
  { status: "goal_defined", goal: "..." }
  → Transición a ADD_TASKS
